title: Davis told definitively that we are monitored and do not control our space
summary: Eric Davis tells of Davis told definitively that we are monitored and do not control our space, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: 100. Because it was definitive. It was that was told to me definitively, not speculatively. It was we know this to be true.

plain: A researcher named Eric Davis says on Jesse Michels's podcast that someone told him, as a fact and not a guess, that humans are being watched and do not control our own space. Davis says he is completely sure of it because it was put to him as something known to be true. If that is right, something other than us would be in charge of the skies above us.
